review: bounded-resource-search-low-health@1 (handler long.bounded-resource-search-low-health, scope long-ex26, learning 1 with no study energy, prerequisites and dependencies navigate, probe and gather, package dependencies foundation-forest@1, foundation-open@1, bounded-resource-search@1 and bounded-resource-search-recheck@1, references {} because no parameter names a target, execution duration null with cancel interruption, visualComponents [] with view metadata on every event, no satisfaction rule, process or resource, practiceEvidence its completion event, which never carries a qualified flag) is the general operation bounded resource search with a low-health mode for any person and any known resource. Versioning: v7Install refuses a repeated ability id or equivalence and nothing supersedes or retires an installed interface, so a same-id bounded-resource-search-recheck@2 is not supported and a new package was added with ability id bounded-resource-search-low-health, equivalence forage:bounded-search-and-collection:low-health:1, event prefix search-low-health- and its own state keys, each checked unique against every registered package; bounded-resource-search-recheck@1 and bounded-resource-search@1 stay byte-identical (their package hashes and those of all 140 earlier packages are unchanged by an id@version map) and the recheck module only gained an export block of aliases. Reuse: the stop lines (recheckRisks), avoided areas and directions (recheckZones, recheckAvoided, recheckZoned), the candidate order (recheckByGap), the parameter schema, the costs text and the eat-cost reserve of recheck@1, and the candidate collection of @1 (searchSources: perceived now through v7Observe at vision 5 or remembered by the person out of view, inside the radius, not made by another person, not left out), its lower-bound pricing (searchBinding, searchFits), its exploration over observed dry ground (searchPlace) and its fact record (searchNote) are called, not copied; every step is the dependency handler itself, once per round: the kernel navigate step v7NavigateStep (priced first on a copy of the person, at most speed x dt = 0.8 per round, distance x 2 effort raised by ground and load, and a step faster than navigate throws), OPEN_FOUNDATION.handlers open.probe in observe mode (reach, 0.2 energy, its observed-state record and event) and FOREST_BASE.handlers forest.gather (reach, real stock, 2 energy per unit, owned item). Without lowHealth the operation takes the same decisions as recheck@1, tested round by round against it over 24 plans and 92 rounds (the same people, objects, items, processes, event identities and wording, records and outcome reasons), a starving run with emergency included, which an injury still stops as in recheck@1; outside lowHealth minHealth keeps the range 60 to 100 of recheck@1, and a lower value is refused at no cost. open-experience.ts adds the interface to the subsistence routine and to the navigate progress check only where bounded-resource-search-low-health@1 is installed, so every other run replays unchanged. Modeling assumptions: (1) lowHealth: true replaces only the health <= 60 stop with health <= minHealth (default 20, declared range 20 to 100, validated again in code) and drops the satiety <= 8 stop (it implies emergency); any injury of the preceding round other than starvation alone, body temperature 10 or more from 22 (12 or below, 32 or above), the supplied minTemp and maxTemp (12 to 32, min below max), the reserve and every limit still stop it; vitals and budgets are checked at the start of every round before its one step, that is after the previous step and the environment that followed it, and a step that does not fit is not taken; death is health 0, below every threshold, and a death while paused ends the run; (2) in lowHealth mode damage of the preceding round that was starvation alone does not stop it and health <= minHealth governs it instead: the person's own records must show exactly one injured record that round, the physiology damage described as starvation (forest-environment.ts emits it with data.starvation and data.thermal), and exactly the world's starvation damage of 8 lost since the health that the package keeps for a person who has mastered it while their satiety is 0 or less, recorded after the round's environment and just before its physiology (the handler cannot read the previous round's event data, so this measured loss stands for thermal 0 and no other damage); anything else (thermal exposure, damage beyond 8, a second injured record, attacks, food toxicity, or no kept health) is an injury that stops it, as in @1, and outside lowHealth every injury still stops it; because starvation takes 8 health per round and the threshold is at least 20, every step round begins above 20 and an active run never steps into a starvation death; (3) in lowHealth mode radius, path, time, energy and quantity must be supplied, finite and above 0, and reserve finite and 0 or more; the origin is the person's own position unless both x and y are given; (4) food means a resource with nutrition above 0, the rule recheck@1 already uses for its reserve; a lowHealth food search needs a reserve of at least 1 energy, the registered cost of eat, and the person's own eating record of that resource (memory.discoveries, written only by eat) with nutrition above 0 and toxicity exactly 0, never another person's record or the world's food table; a resource that is not food needs neither; (5) candidates are those of recheck@1: ripe sources seen now or remembered by the person inside the radius, nearest reach first, then with recheck sources last seen without ripe stock, each probed at most once per run; a remembered place is only a navigate destination, stock is learned only by probe within reach, and hidden stock, unobserved sources and ground outside perception are never read; with no candidate it walks to observed dry ground to see unseen parts, or ends search-exhausted; (6) one navigate, probe or gather step per round, each priced first against path, time, energy budget and reserve; paused rounds count toward time; another action pauses it, resume revalidates the vitals and probes again before any harvest, cancel and death end it without refunds or transfers, and carried units follow the ordinary death rules; (7) nothing is created, eaten, healed or rewarded, and eating stays a separate eat action; a probe made by the search keeps the observation events of probe but earns no satisfaction (the same probe by hand can), and repeated empty inspections earn nothing; (8) events and records add lowHealth to the modes and minHealth and a complete flag, true only when the quantity is collected, to the view. In the archived round-154 world Kai (health 36, satiety 5.3, energy 15.75, his own berry record of nutrition 8 and toxicity 0) can study it in one round, after which a feasible step exists: with recheck (berry, radius 8, path 16, time 20, energy 12, reserve 1, quantity 4) its first step probes the empty bush commons-berry-3-0 within reach for 0.2 energy; navigate then refuses the goal of forest-berry-4, which shares its place with dry grass (goal-overlap, left out at no cost, a round without a step), start-5-berries, 2.97 away, is reached in three steps and probed empty, and one step walks toward unseen observed ground; that is 6 steps in 7 rounds, while his satiety reaches 0 and starvation alone takes his health from 36 to 28 and 20, and the eighth round stops it at health 20 (12 after that round), without recheck 7 exploration steps before the same stop; every berry source Kai knows was empty when last seen, so no food is assured.
